meta.title: The Signal Beneath the Ice
meta.subtitle: ❄️ A mysterious signal begins broadcasting from beneath an abandoned Arctic research station.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.
meta.footerText: ❄️ The Signal Beneath the Ice · Chapter One

scenes.title: 📡 The Distress Signal
scenes.narrative:
A brutal Arctic wind cuts across the frozen plain as your snowmobile sputters to a stop outside Outpost Aurora.

🏔 The research station was abandoned five years ago.

Three nights ago, a strange signal began broadcasting from this exact location.

No satellite or radio system can identify it.

The station sits dark beneath the snow.

A faint light flickers from the communications tower.

Then beneath your boots… the ice vibrates.

Something here is still active.

choices.text: 🔍 Scan the ice with your equipment

scenes.title: 🔬 The Abandoned Laboratory
scenes.narrative:
The station door groans open.

🚨 Emergency lights glow red across overturned desks and scattered research notes.

A frozen coffee cup still sits beside a humming terminal.

One message loops endlessly on the screen:

"It wasn't buried.
It was waiting."

At the back of the room, a sealed elevator leads down into the ice.

From somewhere below… you hear metallic scratching.

scenes.title: 📶 The Communications Tower
scenes.narrative:
The tower ladder rattles violently in the freezing wind.

At the top sits a massive antenna dish covered in modified equipment.

📻 Suddenly your radio crackles.

Then a whisper cuts through the static:

"You shouldn't be here."

The signal is coming from beneath the ice.

The tower is amplifying it.

Far below, something moves across the frozen surface.

scenes.title: 📝 The Research Discovery
scenes.narrative:
You activate the terminal.

Most of the files are corrupted.

One surviving log opens automatically:

"Day 47 — We drilled too deep. Something ancient is transmitting through the ice. It reacts to sound… and attention."

Another warning flashes across the monitor:

"DO NOT AMPLIFY THE SIGNAL."

⚡ Suddenly the lights flicker.

Outside, the ice cracks loudly.

Something below now knows you are here.

scenes.title: ❄️ The Ice Chamber
scenes.narrative:
The elevator descends deep beneath the station.

When the doors open, you step into a massive cavern carved into the ice.

At its center sits a black object frozen into the wall.

💡 It pulses with dim blue light.

It isn't metal.

It isn't stone.

And it is broadcasting the signal.

The surface ripples slowly… like something breathing.

📻 Your radio activates by itself.

"Observer detected."

The cavern begins to shake.

Then you realize the truth.

The signal was never a distress call.

It was a beacon.

scenes.title: ✅ Humanity Saved
scenes.narrative:
You destroy the object.

💥 The cavern collapses as the signal abruptly dies.

Days later, satellites confirm the strange broadcasts have vanished worldwide.

Whatever was beneath the ice…

is gone.

Or buried once more.

scenes.title: 🤫 Silent Victory
scenes.narrative:
You disable the tower amplifier.

📡 Immediately the signal weakens.

Without amplification, whatever lies beneath the ice falls silent once again.

The world never learns how close it came to awakening.

Some things are safer left buried.

scenes.title: 👽 First Contact
scenes.narrative:
You speak into the radio.

💡 The object pulses violently.

Then the cavern fills with blinding light.

Your mind floods with impossible visions:

🌌 Stars.
Alien worlds.
Civilizations long extinct.

The signal was never a weapon.

It was a message waiting for someone to answer.

And now… you have.

Humanity is no longer alone.

scenes.title: ☠️ Beneath the Ice
scenes.narrative:
The frozen ground cracks apart beneath you.

🌊 Something massive moves below the ice.

Before you can react, the surface shatters.

A black shape erupts from the depths.

📻 Your radio screams with static.

Then silence.

The signal continues broadcasting.

Waiting for the next listener.
